orgName: AlUla Tour (ASO / Royal Commission for AlUla / Saudi Ministry of Sport)

source.name: The AlUla Tour - Partners page (Main partner)
source.note: 'Main partner' tier lists Manahil l Nissan (en.nissan-manahil.com); institutional partners are the Saudi Ministry of Sport (mos.gov.sa), the Saudi Cycling Federation (sacf.sa), AlUla (rcu.gov.sa) and Saudi Palmier Olympique (olympic.sa).

note: Main (commercial) partner of the 2026 AlUla Tour. Fee not published. ASO (Amaury Sport Organisation) runs the race site (c ASO).
